text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx rate from inference gateway  → severity: P1. Affected route: /v1/generate, region: us-west-2.

Kiran (oncall): seeing 502/504 spike, thank you. I'm on it.

Claire (support): customers reporting timeouts in production, several tenants high TPS. Narrowing to models: rdl-7b-quant / rdl-13b-int8.

Marie (runtime): logs from one model-runner show repeated SIGSEGV then restart loop. snippet:
```
model-runner[pid=23456]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f3a6a1b2c offset 0x1234
[stack trace omitted]
OOM killer invoked for process model-runner
```

Devin (model infra): any recent rollout for quant kernels? We just deployed a quant kernel optimization four hours ago.

Marie (runtime): yes, kernel update landed ~4h ago. We see failures on quant path only. Non-quant variants stable.

Kiran (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) take the failing model variant out of routing (reroute to non-quant fallback) 2) isolate nodes that are crashing 3) evict jobs from faulty pool and scale up healthy pool. I'll start reroute now.

Kiran (oncall): /reroute --route /v1/generate --from_variant rdl-13b-int8 --to_variant rdl-13b-fp16 --percent 100 :arrow_right: (executed)

ops-bot: Reroute executed by Kiran. Traffic to rdl-13b-int8 -> rdl-13b-fp16. Rolling for all customer namespaces in us-west-2.

Claire (support): posting customer-facing note: "We're investigating elevated errors and have rerouted traffic to a stable model variant. Some requests may be slower; we will follow up when root cause identified." Shall I send?

Devin (model infra): please hold notification for 10m until we confirm fallback stability. If latency spike is acceptable, send update.

Marie (runtime): isolating nodes: marking node-gpu-17 and node-gpu-19 cordoned from scheduler, collecting core dumps. Core shows null-deref in fused-attention quant kernel.

Kiran (oncall): starting drain on node-gpu-17/19. Evicting running instances.

Marie (runtime): quick workaround: set env REDWOOD_DISABLE_QUANT_KERNS=1 for model-runner on the pool, which forces FP16 path. Patching now via remote config.

Kiran (oncall): patch applied to pool: redwood-pool-quant-usw2. Observing drop in 5xx within 90s.

ops-bot: Alert: 5xx rate decreased from 18% -> 1.6% in 2 minutes after reroute + quant-disable.

Claire (support): ok to send update now. Draft: "We routed traffic to a non-quant variant and disabled a quant kernel that caused crashes. Error rates have dropped. Expect full recovery in progress. Follow-up postmortem will be shared"

Devin (model infra): we should roll back the kernel change on canary until a fix lands. Also mark the kernel build ID 2026-04-12-quant-v3 as bad.

Marie (runtime): capturing traces and KV cache state for repro. Will try to reproduce with small prompt locally on a test node. If we can repro, we can add an assertion and hotfix.

Kiran (oncall): customer impact summary so far: ~6% of requests for top-3 tenants saw errors briefly during surge window, some experienced elevated latency after reroute. No data plane exfiltration.

Claire (support): notifying impacted customers with the draft message and link to status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1766667777

Devin (model infra): starting blocked kernel tag in registry and disabling autoscaling into quant pool.

Marie (runtime): running reproducer: small script causing segfault on quant path on test machine. Stack points to fused_attention::compute_quantized() line 412. Creating branch to add bounds checks.

Kiran (oncall): handoff plan: I'll stay until stabilization, then hand to oncall-night at 1766674800. Please add any followups to the thread.

ops-bot: Pager acknowledged by Kiran.

Claire (support): update sent to customers.

Devin (model infra): created incident ticket in JIRA INF-3387, assigned to Marie for hotfix and to Devin for kernel rollback.

Marie (runtime): hotfix branch pushed (hotfix/quant-bounds-fix). Running CI build now. If green we'll stage to canary and then roll to affected pools.

Kiran (oncall): monitoring for 30m post-fix. If 5xx stays < 2% and customer complaints quiet, we move to mitigated.

ops-bot: Note: automated rollback of quant kernel will keep quant builds disabled until INF-3387 resolved.

Claire (support): thanks all. Will follow up with customers when fix is deployed.

Devin (model infra): next steps: revert optimization on kernel canary, keep fallback routing for 1 hour, prepare postmortem draft.

Marie (runtime): CI green, canary deploy scheduled to redwood-test-1 now. I'll report canary results in 10m.

Kiran (oncall): thanks team. Leaving follow-up action items: 1) postmortem (owner: Kiran) 2) backport fix to release branches (Marie) 3) notify legal for any high-profile customers (Claire) 4) add integration test covering quant attention edge-case (Devin).

ops-bot: Thread pinned to incident channel.

Marie (runtime): canary looks good — no segfaults on 2k synthetic requests. Scheduling rollback of REDWOOD_DISABLE_QUANT_KERNS to re-enable once kernel patched.

Kiran (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Will open PSIRT if customers request high-severity investigation.

Claire (support): sending final customer message and closing support ticket list.

Devin (model infra): created post-incident checklist and assigned follow-ups.

Kiran (oncall): handing off to night oncall. Logging final note: impact limited, root cause traced to fused-attention quant kernel bounds-check bug introduced in recent optimization.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> MITIGATED (mitigated_by: Kiran).
